text_block_list.text:
Unleashing a breathtaking blitz of speed, 
Taiki Shuttle conquered the Sprinters 
Stakes!

Taiki Shuttle's thrilling race sent 
shivers of excitement through the crowd.

Her legs, knowing no bounds, now head 
toward... The decisive battle for the 
autumn mile crown—the Mile Championship!

She set out to achieve two great feats: 
conquering both spring and autumn Mile 
GⅠs, as well as conquering the autumn 
Sprint GⅠ!
